title: centaurea boissieri subsp. funkii
intro: Centaurea boissieri subsp. funkii, commonly known as the Balkan knapweed, is a plant species within the sunflower family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Centaurea boissieri subsp. funkii include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of digestive problems, pain, and inflammation. The plant's bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, exhibit therapeutic actions like analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
